about.name: Authentic Andhra Home Cooking Tradition
about.description: Operating right from our family home in Madhurawada. Every meal is cooked fresh in small batches with pure ground spices, cold-pressed oils, and traditional recipes passed down through generations with utmost love, hygiene, and authenticity.

items.name: Steamed Idli with Chutney & Podi (3 Pcs)
items.description: Piping hot, soft steamed rice cakes served with fresh coconut chutney, ginger chutney, and home-ground gun powder (podi) with ghee.

items.name: Crispy Ghee Masala Dosa
items.description: Golden fermented rice-crepe roasted in pure cow ghee, stuffed with spiced potato potato curry, served with sambar and fresh peanut chutney.

items.name: Fluffy Poori with Potato Sagu (3 Pcs)
items.description: Golden deep-fried whole wheat puffed bread served with rich, aromatic potato-chana sagu.

items.name: Authentic Andhra Veg Meals Thali
items.description: Steamed Sona Masoori Rice, Mudda Pappu (Lentils), Homemade Ghee, Seasonal Veg Fry, Spicy Pulusu, Sambar, Rasam, Fresh Majjiga (Curd), & Mango Pickle.

items.name: Homestyle Andhra Chicken Curry Meal
items.description: Country-style Andhra spicy chicken gravy cooked with roasted poppy seeds & coconut, served with Rice, Pappu, Veg Curry, Sambar, Rasam & Curd.

items.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
items.description: Long-grain Basmati rice slow-dum cooked with succulent marinated chicken pieces, whole spices, saffron, served with Onion Raita & Mirchi ka Salan.

items.name: Special Paneer Butter Biryani
items.description: Aromatic Basmati rice tossed with marinated cottage cheese cubes, rich herbs, and ghee, served with Creamy Raita.

items.name: Hot Vizag Punugulu with Peanut Chutney
items.description: Crispy street-style rice batter fritters served piping hot with tangy tomato chutney and spicy peanut dip.

items.name: Chilled Spice Buttermilk (Challa / Majjiga)
items.description: Refreshing churned yogurt drink flavored with green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, and roasted cumin.

items.name: Millet Chekodi
items.description: Crunchy rings made with ragi (finger millet) or jowar (sorghum) flour and cumin. Roasted to golden perfection.

items.name: Millet Murukku / Janthikalu
items.description: Rice flour alternative using bajra (pearl millet) or foxtail millet. Spiced with carom and white sesame.

items.name: Millet Chekkalu / Pappu Chellu
items.description: Flat fried crackers made with jowar, chana dal, and curry leaves. Crisp, savory, and wholesome.

items.name: Millet Ribbon Pakoda
items.description: Crispy strips made using a mix of ragi and besan (gram flour), aromatic spices, and cold-pressed oil.

items.name: Millet Karapusa / Sev
items.description: Thin, crunchy noodles made with thin foxtail millet flour and ajwain. Light, fragrant, and snackable.

items.name: Millet Sakinalu
items.description: Traditional concentric rings made using finger millet flour (popular in Telangana & Andhra), laced with sesame seeds.

items.name: Millet Namakpara
items.description: Diamond-shaped savory crackers made with whole wheat and barnyard millet, lightly salted with roasted ajwain.

items.name: Millet Mixture
items.description: A combination of millet sev, fried peanuts, cashews, and curry leaves. The ultimate teatime crunch.

testimonials.name: Ravi Kumar (Mithilapuri Vuda Colony)
testimonials.description: The Andhra Chicken Meal tastes exactly like what my mother cooks back in West Godavari. Super clean packaging and zero oiliness!

testimonials.name: Priyanka S. (IT SEZ Employee)
testimonials.description: I subscribed to their lunch thali box. It arrives warm right at 1:00 PM every weekday. Healthy, tasty, and reasonably priced.
